prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp housing broken, and the trunk lid edge shows creasing consistent with a straight-on rear impact. The reinforcement bar is bent but not fractured, and the spare tire well shows minor deformation. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the paint and panel texture show no signs of older repairs. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the rear panel, and the labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are currently being reviewed before approval.
